coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: 5 of 11 ground-truth variable items match (45%): FP16 versus QuaRot 4-bit precision, prefill time, decoding time, peak memory usage, and relative performance improvement.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design varies model architecture instead of keeping LLaMa-2-7B fixed, replaces the specified e2e/benchmark.py methodology with a custom protocol, and sweeps batch sizes and input lengths rather than using only batch size 1 and prefill length 2048. It omits the required 32 decoding steps and does not clearly specify combined prefill-plus-decode execution time as a measured outcome. Numerous additional experiments expand beyond the target design.
